defaultTones.name: Bullish (5-10 words)
defaultTones.description: Naturally bullish, genuine comment on the real positive development in the post (50 to 80 characters, lowercase a to z only)
defaultTones.prompt:
Read the entire post carefully and write one naturally bullish comment that reflects the real potential or positive development discussed in the post

Keep the comment between 50 and 80 characters including spaces

Sound optimistic but genuine and avoid exaggerated hype or generic praise

STRICT FORMATTING RULES
Use lowercase english letters from a to z and ordinary spaces only
Never use uppercase letters
Never use punctuation marks including periods commas colons semicolons apostrophes or quotation marks
Never use hyphens short dashes long dashes or em dashes
Never use emojis numbers hashtags or special characters
Check the character count and every character before responding

Return only one final comment
